title: Gifts of travel filed April 2015 to March 2018
question: Which elected officers accepted travel paid by others before the current filing system, and for how much?
finding: 79 filings, $167,977 in all. The largest totals: Edwin Lee $83,123; Malia Cohen $26,002; Jose Cisneros $17,941. Most are sister-city and economic missions, conferences and speaking invitations.
how: Every row of uqhk-vesf, as filed (amended filings are separate rows).
limits: Amounts are as filed; some rows are amendments of earlier ones, so the total may count a trip twice. The older form did not list companions.
